newsitem.title: UK: Psion gains on placing news, outlook.
newsitem.headline: Psion gains on placing news, outlook.

text.p: Shares in British personal computer maker Psion gained over nine percent on Thursday after the company said it was placing 3.5 million new ordinary shares to raise around 14 million stg to expand business in 1997.
Psion said demand across its main geographic markets was ahead of expectations and that current trading performance was on target. The shares would be placed at 400p each.
Psion shares gained strongly on the news, touching an intraday high of 433p before settling back to 426-1/2p by 1014 GMT, up 30p on the day. Just over half a million shares had changed hands.
The new shares represent around five percent of the firm's issued ordinary share capital and dealings are expected to start on November 19.
